references.title: Kyoto Station - 55368459767.jpg
references.description:
Kyoto Station is one of Japan's busiest and most architecturally striking transportation hubs, serving as the primary gateway to the historic city with extensive Shinkansen, JR, and subway lines connecting it to major destinations across the country. 
Designed by architect Hiroshi Hara and opened in 1997, the massive complex features a dramatic glass-and-steel atrium, futuristic escalators, a vast shopping mall, restaurants, and a rooftop garden, blending modern functionality with impressive scale.

references.title: Kyoto Station C0389.jpg
references.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Fg2 assumed (based on copyright claims).
references.description:
This photo shows the exterior of Kyoto Station in Kyoto, Japan. The architect is Hiroshi Hara. The view is from the Karasuma Street (the north) side. The reflection of the tip of Kyoto Tower is prominently visible. On the left side of the photo, and near the top, and on the right side, are guest rooms of the Granvia Hotel in the station building.

I took the photo on December 28, 2006, and contribute my rights in the file to the public domain.
